name: @bunest/cli
description: Bun-native CLI for scaffolding, code generation, dev watch, and building Bunest applications

scripts.build: bun build ./src/cli.ts --outfile ./dist/cli.js --target bun --format esm --external @bunest/core --external @bunest/core/common --external @bunest/core/http --external @bunest/core/config --external @bunest/core/client --external @bunest/core/ws --external @bunest/core/i18n && bun build ./src/index.ts --outfile ./dist/index.js --target bun --format esm --external @bunest/core --external @bunest/core/common --external @bunest/core/http --external @bunest/core/config --external @bunest/core/client --external @bunest/core/ws --external @bunest/core/i18n && bun build ./src/analyzer/index.ts --outfile ./dist/analyzer.js --target bun --format esm --external @bunest/core --external @bunest/core/common --external @bunest/core/http --external @bunest/core/config --external @bunest/core/client --external @bunest/core/ws --external @bunest/core/i18n
